By Staff ,
5 hours ago Square Feet: 9,308 | MLS#: 1589915 | Year Built: 1920s. SCHOOLS: Stone Academy | League Academy | Greenville High. Welcome to Oakleaf, an iconic Greenville estate where timeless architecture and modern luxury converge across approximately three private, beautifully landscaped acres in the heart of downtown. Surrounded by majestic oaks, magnolias, and curated gardens, this legacy property offers extraordinary privacy just minutes from Downtown Greenville. Notably rooted in the 1920s, Oakleaf has been thoughtfully reimagined for modern living while honoring its architectural heritage. With over 9,300 square feet spanning the main residence, carriage house, and fully redesigned guest house, this rare estate offers unmatched flexibility for multigenerational living or a luxurious private retreat. The main residence encompasses over 6,500 square feet with five bedrooms and six-and-a-half baths, blending elegant English manor influence with sophisticated updates—featuring a main-level primary suite with garden access, chef’s kitchen, and wine cellar. Across the estate, seven bedrooms and nine-and-a-half baths provide remarkable accommodations amid winding brick walkways and manicured courtyards—a sanctuary designed to live beautifully for generations to come.
